claimDispositions.reason: Autotekst speech-to-text service is free for staff and students under institutional terms.
Google Gemini is free for staff and students; restricted to green and yellow data classes.
GPT UiO is freely accessible via Feide login; designated models support red confidential data.
Microsoft Copilot Chat is available for students and staff; restricted to green open data.
Microsoft Foundry requires employee ordering and incurs departmental costs; not student tool.
Formerly NotebookLM, now titled Gemini Notebook; free for students under UiO Google Workspace.
TSD-Autotekst is restricted to users with active projects in Services for Sensitive Data.
Students are instructed to use AI for inspiration/support while submitting independent work.
Official rules confirm AI permissions vary across subjects and specific assignments.
Faculty guidelines instruct educators to issue clear directives when allowing AI in assessment.
Historic canonical yellow-data tier is superseded by current GPT UiO model support for red data; retained as historical baseline.
GPT UiO is recommended as primary privacy-compliant AI choice for students.

gaps: Microsoft Foundry is restricted to employee orders with associated departmental costs; general student access remains an unverified gap.
Only specific designated models within GPT UiO are approved for red (confidential) data; standard Copilot is strictly restricted to green (open) data.
There is no blanket university-wide exam authorization for AI tools; assessment conditions vary by subject and are determined by faculty examiner directives.
Formal faculty investigation workflows and committee sanction outcome schedules under UiO cheating procedures are not fully evidenced by the national board appeal channel excerpt.

do.en: Check the AI rules for your subject and specific assignment.
do.zh: 核对所属学科及具体作业的AI使用规则。

do.en: Clearly show when and how you have used AI in assignments and submissions in accordance with course instructions.
do.zh: 按课程要求在作业与提交物中明确说明何时及如何使用了AI。

dont.en: Do not submit predominantly AI-generated text, code, or analysis as your own work; editing does not negate cheating.
dont.zh: 切勿将主要由AI生成的文本、代码或分析作为原创成果提交；生成后的文字润色并不能免除作弊定性。

dont.en: Check the current data-classification limit for the specific model before entering confidential data.
dont.zh: 输入机密数据前，核对具体模型当前允许的数据级别。

claim-uio-ai-support-transparency.text: UiO's student guidance presents AI as support rather than a replacement for the student's own work and tells students to show clearly when and how they used AI.

evidence.quote: Bruk KI som støtte, ikke som en erstatning for eget arbeid. Vis tydelig når og hvordan du har brukt KI.
evidence.location: Grunnregler for bruk av kunstig intelligens (KI)

claim-uio-ai-permission-varies.text: UiO tells students that permitted AI use varies between subjects and assignments, and that they should ask their teacher if they are unsure what is allowed.

evidence.quote: Reglene for bruk av kunstig intelligens (KI) vil variere mellom fag og oppgaver. Spør alltid underviseren din hvis du er usikker på hva som er tillatt.
evidence.location: Introductory guidance section

claim-uio-teacher-ai-guidelines.text: UiO's teacher guidance says that when teachers allow AI use, they should provide clear AI-use guidelines and communicate academic integrity, accuracy, and source-use requirements to students.

evidence.quote: If you allow the use of AI Provide clear guidelines for the use of AI, and emphasize the importance of taking privacy, copyright and ethics into account Clearly communicate the requirements for academic integrity, accuracy and use of sources to the students.
evidence.location: If you allow the use of AI

claim-uio-student-privacy-tools.text: UiO recommends GPT UiO or Microsoft Copilot for students because, according to the student guidance, personal data and submitted data are not shared onward and conversations are not used to train future models.

evidence.quote: Vi anbefaler at du bruker GPT UiO eller Microsoft Copilot, da er dataene dine trygge. Verken personopplysninger eller data du legger inn blir delt videre. Samtaler vil heller ikke bli brukt til å trene framtidige modeller.
evidence.location: KI-verktøy i studiene

coursework:uio-coursework-rules-vary-gro.text: UiO student guidance says rules for AI use vary between subjects and assignments.

coursework:uio-coursework-rules-vary-gro.scope: All undergraduate and graduate coursework components

evidence.quote: Reglene for bruk av kunstig intelligens vil variere mellom fag og oppgaver.
evidence.location: Grunnregler for bruk av KI, variation across courses

exams:uio-exams-examiner-guidance-group.text: The retained source says UiO examination regulations focus on the student’s answer being their own work.

exams:uio-exams-examiner-guidance-group.scope: Course examinations, home exams, and portfolio assessments

evidence.quote: UiO's examination regulations focus on the student's answer being their own work
evidence.location: Assessment activities, individual work requirement

disclosure:uio-disclosure-own-reflection.text: Student guidelines state that submitted assignments must reflect personal knowledge and interpretation; students must clearly show when and how AI was used.

evidence.quote: Tekst, kode, analyser eller påstander som i hovedsak er generert av KI, regnes som fusk – også hvis du har bearbeidet dem etterpå
evidence.location: KI-bruk og fusk, core fraud standard

academic_integrity:uio-appeals-national-.text: Student cases committee determinations regarding cheating may be formally appealed to the National Appeals Board (Felles klagenemnd).
